GetExitCodeProcess query failure retains state. STILL_ACTIVE259 polls; unsigned DWORD elapsed >=1800000 raises one warning then continues. Exit kills timer/closes handle/clears slot and dispatches actual exit code.

Current path helper validates directory/relative input, adds separator only when needed, calls GetFullPathNameA with260B buffer and containment checks. Address1..255 chars of ASCII alnum/dot/hyphen/colon/brackets; port1..5decimal chars and numeric1..65535. Full locale/FS conditions are separate.
